remarks:
Where else would you rather be than right here, right now? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be an integral part of the most exciting development opportunity in WNY. 

We are offering six parcels encompassing a total of 5.6 acres, all just a stone's throw away from the Bills stadium.

These parcels are not just land; they are revenue generators, serving as parking lots for the stadium, bringing in significant income on a few event days each year. Their potential goes beyond parking. With R3 zoning and a prime location, they are perfectly suited for residential multifamily development. Imminent town re-zoning will bring commercial development possibilities as well. 

* Update * The parcels to the north of Big Tree have been rezoned for commercial development (DR2), with the other parcels likely to follow.

Here's a breakdown of the parcels:

1.The Famous Yellow Brick Parking: This is 1 acre property includes an impeccably maintained brick single-family home.
2. 2 acre mostly cleared parcel featuring a gravel driveway and parking area.
3. 1.88 acre wooded lot on Abbott.
4. Cleared lot on 109 Oakwood.
5 & 6. Prime Cleared lots on the north side of Big Tree.

The preference is to sell all six parcels together, but will consider offers for all of the vacant land (parcels 2 – 6; refer to MLS# B1503041).
